reviews.title: KEEP PHOTOS SAFE, they say
reviews.text: The app’s main purpose… or so they say… is to keep photos safe. But they don’t actually have the backbone to do so. I was kayaking, and my phone accidentally fell into the water, lost forever. But I wasn’t that worried about it. I had it backed up, everything. I wouldn’t lose anything more than an iPhone. I was able to restore everything back to how it was before. Except for the most unreliable app I owned. Keepsafe. My biometric login didn’t maintain after the new install on my new phone, restored from a cloud backup. My PIN number didn’t save. That was how I logged into the app for so long, that it had slipped my mind that it was associated with an email address that I no longer used. But that email had been deleted permanently. I reached out to Keepsafe, whom I trusted to keep my photos safe, and I guess they are safe, in the way that something is safe in a vault at the bottom of an ocean, they’re safe and unattainable. But their customer service was so helpful! Actually not. After getting a lecture on not having a secondary email set up, and taking themselves way too seriously, I was told that there was nothing they could do for me. Which objectively is not true… there is just nothing they are willing to do for me. Because keeping photos “safe” is what they do, even when it means keeping photos away from the person who owns them. reviews.title: Moving multiple files off the app is an absolute nightmare!
reviews.text: It’s a nicely polished app with some real great overall functions.  I have no issues adding images and videos to the folders in the app. It’s when I want to copy them from the app over to my computer that it’s a total pain due to some real basic features missing.  If I want to copy a few photos over, I can use the “copy to camera roll” or just AirDrop them, no biggie.  But I have thousands of files saved and I have to select one by one! Or I can “select all” which just makes the app crash 100% of the time I’ve tried transferring more than a couple hundred images. So I have to sit there for hours transferring files 100 at a time. Even then I have to restart my phone after every 2 or 3 batches or it just fails transferring after a few batches. This could be remedied by having the ability to simply plug your phone into the computer and copy/pasting them over via Finder. Plenty of other kinds of apps have this feature and it’s a such a breeze. If that can’t be added for some reason, at least let me swipe to select so I don’t have to sit there tapping each file one by one!  As soon as I’m done getting all my files off the app, I’m deleting it and canceling my premium membership without a doubt. Would not recommend if you’re planning on having more than a few hundred files and/or hope to move some files out of the app at any point.
